description: Looks up a patient's scheduled appointments by phone number.

request_body.phone: string - patient phone number to search
request_body.schedule_form: number, optional (v4) - none/0=All, 1=Appointment, 3=Agenda. VERIFIED 2026-09-07: even with 0 or 3 this endpoint returns NOTFOUND for a phone that only has an Agenda/lead record - it appears to resolve the phone to a CRM patient first, and leads have no patient record. Use get_schedule.php (schedule_form=0) + client-side phone filter for leads.

response.status_200_found_note: VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-07 with CRM test patient 'Paciens Teszt' / 123123123 and schedule_form=0: JSON array, same record shape as get_schedule.php (incl. form + scheduleid). schedule_form=3 on the same phone -> NOTFOUND (no agenda records). Phones with only leads -> NOTFOUND regardless of schedule_form.

verification_caveat: Found path verified 2026-09-07 for a CRM patient; lead-only phones are never found.
